title: custody.confirmed body
description: Tells a task's holder that the team services recorded its custody, with its custody token and custody window, and, on a host whose certificate names its tools, the task's access list. The team services send it again with the same custody token to renew a window or to replace the access list. The frame carries the task's authority token when the work has one: the only way the holder of pool work receives it (README, "On behalf of a person", "Custody windows").

sequence.description: The team services number their confirmations for each task from 1, across custody tokens; the holder applies a confirmation only when its sequence is higher than the last one it applied.

reason.description: Why it was sent: a claim was recorded, the task was reassigned to this holder, a lapsed or ending window is renewed after the host reconnected, or the task's access list changed.

access_list.description: Present exactly when the holder's host certificate names its tools.
